gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-noto-sans-kharoshthi: Wallpoet is bold and commanding, with paper showing through between its letters. Noto Sans Kharoshthi sets a dark, sturdy stripe of lowercase beneath it, and its open curves feel approachable against the display weight.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-noto-sans-khmer: Noto Sans Khmer is clean and modern, with small letters standing tall. Wallpoet above it is all bold command, a smooth-bending display face with a thin line of paper between letters.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-noto-sans-khojki: Loud, confident and cut with gaps: that's Wallpoet up top. Noto Sans Khojki brings modern, wide exits and a large eye on every e, so loudness meets light.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-noto-sans-khudawadi: Big, brash and cut through with paper-thin gaps, Wallpoet takes the headline. And Noto Sans Khudawadi reads clean and approachable, its small letters close to capital height and its rounds left unlatched.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-noto-sans-kr: Wallpoet is bold and commanding, its high-rising lowercase split by a line of paper. Noto Sans KR has generous gaps in its curves and a big x-height, giving the heading room to shout.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-noto-sans-lao: Paper shows through between the letters of Wallpoet, loud and commanding. Noto Sans Lao counters that volume with open mouths and a lofty x-height, a modern body that lets the display face shout.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-noto-sans-lao-looped: Noto Sans Lao Looped reads in solid, compact blocks of words. Its bowls are left unfinished on one side, so lines flow along smoothly, and Wallpoet above brings bold, commanding punch.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-noto-sans-limbu: Noto Sans Limbu reads approachable, with tall-bodied small letters and gaping curves. And Wallpoet is the loud one: bold, commanding, with a line of paper showing between its letters.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-noto-sans-mandaic: Wallpoet is bold and commanding, with high-rising lowercase and a thin line of paper showing between its letters. Wallpoet does the shouting; Noto Sans Mandaic handles curvy, unclamped text.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-noto-sans-mayan-numer: Wallpoet is bold and commanding, its smooth bends and high lowercase broken by a thin line of paper. Beneath it, Noto Sans Mayan Numerals adds a gaping c and tall-bodied letters.
